tasks:
unit:
  description: Verify pure string normalization and collection behavior in the
    library, including compatibility tests. Browser components, SQL migrations,
    API specifications and generated clients are outside this task.
  jobs:
    - workflow: .github/workflows/checks.yml
      job: unit
    - workflow: .github/workflows/checks.yml
      job: unit-compat
  context_files:
    - library/test-scope.md
ui:
  description: Verify browser component interactions, accessibility and visual
    styling in the web application. Pure library helpers, SQL migrations and API
    schema validation are outside this task.
  jobs:
    - workflow: .github/workflows/ui.yml
  context_files:
    - web/playwright.config.mjs
schema:
  description: Verify SQL schemas, migration execution, indexes and database
    constraints. Pure library behavior, browser styling and API documentation
    are outside this task.
  jobs:
    - workflow: .github/workflows/checks.yml
      job: schema
  context_files:
    - db/check-scope.md
api:
  description: Verify the API specification and generated TypeScript client agree,
    including request and response shapes. Pure library tests, browser styling
    and SQL migration checks are outside this task.
  jobs:
    - workflow: .github/workflows/checks.yml
      job: api
  context_files:
    - api/check-scope.md
